senses.gloss: (cmp. גמומסית), Pi. גִּמֵּז to couple, esp. to suspend branches of the wild fig on the cultivated (the process called caprification, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Caprificatio).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:11">Tosef. Shebi. I, 11</cite> <he>ומצדדין ומְגַמְּזִין</he> ed. (missing in ed. Zuck.).
